component.name: Battery Health Center
component.summary: Battery health, charge limits and app energy usage in one place

description.p: Battery Health Center brings everything about your laptop battery together in one native GNOME app.

ul.li: Charge level, time remaining and live power draw
Maximum capacity compared with when new, condition and cycle count
Set a maximum charge level to extend your battery's lifespan
Battery level history for the last 24 hours or 7 days
Apps using significant energy, with estimated power draw on battery
Recommendations to make your battery last longer
